title: 第8章  我能拿东西换吗？
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
陆决微垂着头，不知道自己做得对不对。
他刚才没敢用力，不然对方至少会断两根骨头。
万一公主和那个雄性只是暂时吵架了，过后和好怎么办？
得罪主人心仪的雄性，下场会很惨。
一只手伸过来，揉了揉他的头发。
“干得不错。”
陆决头顶的狼耳，瞬间竖了起来。
姜知夏顺手撸了一把，感觉自己在撸狗，很有趣。
陆决涨红了脸，暗戳戳把头低了一些，方便她摸，“主人，还需要我做什么？”
姜知夏被叫萎了，讪讪收回手：“……你先给我把这个称呼改了。”
她适应不了。
陆决不明所以，但听话：“……公主？”
姜知夏满意了。
过了一会儿，她换了衣服牵着陆决出门。
陆决脸上戴着她刚才给的口罩，一言不发跟着上了悬浮车。
姜知夏是担心他顶着刺青出门，再被周围人异样的目光伤害到，但少年沉默着乖乖戴好，甚至连去哪儿都不问。
也不怕她把他拉去卖了。
一路来到帝国中央医院。
三公主的粉色悬浮车格外夺目，不少医护和病患光看车就猜到了公主亲临，忍不住伸着脖子去看。
姜知夏牵着陆决下车，矜贵地抬着下巴，踏进医院。

一路上，众人目光炙热。
姜知夏触及到这些目光，有些困惑。
虽然她是公主，不过原主招摇惯了，应该不少人见过她，怎么盯着自己看？
她以为是因为自己一个雌性来这里比较稀奇。
毕竟帝国的各种治疗基地都是为雄性准备的，雌性们享有帝国的上门体检和医疗服务政策，很少出现在医院。
她没当回事，牵着陆决直接坐进VIP电梯去往顶楼。
电梯门关上的一瞬间，大厅炸开了锅。
“哇，那是三公主？真人比终端上好看多了！”
“和公主手拉手的是谁？不会是未来正夫吧？”
“公主视频里不是说在安排吗？没这么快定好吧……”
姜知夏不知道，因为生日宴上的那段视频爆火，很多单身雄性们对她这位呵护正夫的公主充满好奇，八卦风云。
八卦中心的姜知夏，并不觉得自己牵着陆决有什么不对。
在她26岁的灵魂面前，陆决就是个孩子，手拉手什么的，纯属助人为乐。
一路走到最深处，敲了敲门。
来之前她已经打过招呼，中心医院安排了最顶级的治疗师接待。
她要给陆决看看眼睛。
“进。”
推开门，一个穿着白色长袍的男人正低头看着光屏。
听到声音，他抬起头，然后愣了一下。
“公主殿下。”男人起身行礼。

姜知夏看见他也愣了一下。
男人皮肤白皙，眉眼柔和，五官好看得过分，整个人散发着一种干净温和的气质。
好家伙……颜值这么高？
她回过神，指了指陆决：“别多礼了，给他做个全身检查。”
陆决这时候才反应过来，这趟出行，是主人想给他治眼睛。
他声音发紧：“主……公主，我的眼睛没事，也许过几天就好了。”
自己一个奴隶，怎么配？
姜知夏察觉到他的紧张，轻声安抚：“没事，来都来了，给你看看。”
苏尘很意外三公主居然亲自来。
接收到公主的预约，他以为和平时一样，是家中雌主预约后雄性自己来。
他看向陆决，察觉到他的眼睛不对劲，“摘下口罩，我带你去监测仓检查一下。”
陆决望向姜知夏的方向。
姜知夏：“听医生的话。”
他这才动手，摘下了口罩。
暗色的刺青露了出来，苏尘的眼神几不可察地顿了一下，迅速恢复如常。
原来是个奴隶。
那段视频他看过，昨天才说要尊重正夫，今天就把奴隶的眼睛打坏了？
不过能带奴隶来治病，已经比大多数雌性好多了。
不知道她说要对正夫好是真是假……最近雌母为了攀上皇室，急不可耐要推他去竞选三公主的正夫。
陆决安静地躺进检测舱里。

姜知夏站在旁边，看着这个好看的医生用那双骨节分明的手，在光屏上操作。
苏尘皱一下眉，她紧张地凑近：“怎么样？不太好吗？”
一股极其微弱，但轻柔温馨的香气飘了过来。
苏尘眼眸动了动，“公主，他身上的伤都是皮外伤，S级雄性体质强悍，用不了几天就能好。”
“眼睛呢？”
“眼睛并没有异常，看不清是因为他的精神力长期压抑没有安抚，波动剧烈，所以在受创之后难以恢复。”
姜知夏哑了。
尽说些她没有的东西。
苏尘刚想说“最好能多给他一些精神力安抚”，话到嘴边，才想起这位那众所周知的C级精神力。
况且，也没几个雌性愿意给奴隶安抚。
于是他改口：“公主可以给他用抑制剂。”
姜知夏知道这东西。
帝国早在几百年前就研发了抑制剂，雄性找不到缔结契约的雌性，可以凭借精神力波动异常的证明到医院购买。
并且只能在医院购买，因为抑制剂注入过量，也会导致兽人死亡。
姜知夏回忆了一下，隐约记得抑制剂的效果从高到低分了等级。
她现在菜鸡一个，给不了陆决安抚，只能让他嗑药了。
“行，开最好的。”她大手一挥。
苏尘平静地低头在光凭上记录：“高级抑制剂，三万金币一支。”
姜知夏：“……多少？”
苏尘：“三万金币。”

姜知夏沉默了。
她兜里只剩七万金币。
一支抑制剂只能管一次易感期，三万一个月……真特么贵。
苏尘见她半天不说话，以为她改主意了。
抬头一看，却看见一向挥金如土的三公主艰难地动了动唇。
“那个……我能拿东西换吗？”
苏尘：“……”
半小时后，姜知夏牵着怀里抱着药箱的陆决离开。
苏尘神情复杂注视着她的背影。
等人走了，他才低头看了看。
掌心中，是一块剔透的水晶。
共鸣水晶，价值不菲。
被三公主拿来和他换了三十万金币的抑制剂。
他看了好一会儿，鬼使神差地凑近闻了闻。
水晶上残留着一股极淡的香气，轻柔温软，让人莫名觉得舒畅。
和三公主身上的味道一样。
想起她刚才眨巴着大眼睛，半点没有公主架子地跟他商量换抑制剂，苏尘轻笑了一声。
“你有病？”
一个戏谑的声音突然从身后传来。
content_en:
Lu Jue lowered his head slightly, wondering if he was doing the right thing.
He didn't dare to use force just now, otherwise the opponent would break at least two bones.
What if the princess and the male only had a temporary quarrel and reconciled later?
Offending the male that the owner likes will lead to disastrous consequences.
A hand reached over and rubbed his hair.
"Well done."
The wolf ears on Lu Jue's head stood up instantly.
Jiang Zhixia jerked off a handful, feeling like she was petting a dog, which was very interesting.
Lu Jue blushed and lowered his head a little to make it easier for her to touch, "Master, what else do you need me to do?"
Jiang Zhixia shivered when she was called, and Sansan took back her hand: "...change this title for me first."
She couldn't adapt.
Lu Jue didn't know why, but he obeyed: "...Princess?"
Jiang Zhixia was satisfied.
After a while, she changed her clothes and led Lu Jue out.
Lu Jue wore the mask she had just given him and followed him onto the hovercar without saying a word.
Jiang Zhixia was worried that if he went out with his tattoo on, he would be hurt by the strange looks from the people around him, but the boy kept silent and put it on obediently, without even asking where he was going.
He wasn't afraid that she would drag him away and sell him.
All the way to the Imperial Central Hospital.
The third princess's pink floating car was particularly eye-catching. Many doctors, nurses and patients guessed that the princess was coming just by looking at the car and couldn't help but crane their necks to take a look.
Jiang Zhixia led Lu Jue out of the car, raised her chin dignifiedly, and stepped into the hospital.
Along the way, everyone's eyes were hot.
Jiang Zhixia felt a little confused when she saw these looks.
Although she is a princess, the original owner is used to showing off. Many people must have seen her. Why are they staring at her?
She thought it was because it was unusual for her to be here as a female.
After all, the empire's various treatment bases are prepared for males. Females enjoy the empire's door-to-door physical examination and medical service policy and rarely appear in hospitals.
She didn't take it seriously and took Lu Jue directly into the VIP elevator to the top floor.
The moment the elevator door closed, the hall exploded.
"Wow, is that the third princess? She looks much better in person than on the terminal!"
"Who is holding hands with the princess? Isn't he the future husband?"
"Didn't the princess video say that arrangements are being made? It can't be decided so soon..."
Jiang Zhixia didn't know that because the video at the birthday party went viral, many single men were curious about her, a princess who cared for her husband, and gossiped about her.
Jiang Zhixia, who was at the center of the gossip, didn't think there was anything wrong with him holding Lu Jue.
In front of her 26-year-old soul, Lu Jue is just a child, holding hands and so on, just for the joy of helping others.
He walked all the way to the end and knocked on the door.
She had already said hello before coming, and the central hospital arranged for the top therapist to receive her.
She wanted to show Lu Jue her eyes.
"Come in."
Opening the door, a man in a white robe was looking down at the light screen.
Hearing the sound, he raised his head and was stunned for a moment.
"Your Highness Princess." The man stood up and saluted.
Jiang Zhixia was stunned for a moment when she saw him.
The man has fair skin, soft eyebrows, and overly good-looking facial features. His whole person exudes a clean and gentle temperament.
Good guy...is he so good-looking?
She came to her senses and pointed at Lu Jue: "Stop being polite and give him a full body check."
Only then did Lu Jue realize that the owner wanted to treat his eyes during this trip.
His voice was tight: "Master...Princess, my eyes are fine. Maybe they will be fine in a few days."
How can I deserve to be a slave myself?
Jiang Zhixia noticed his nervousness and comforted him softly: "It's okay. I'm here. Let me show you."
Su Chen was surprised that the third princess actually came in person.
After receiving the reservation from the princess, he thought that as usual, the male would come by himself after the female in the family made the reservation.
He looked at Lu Jue and noticed something was wrong with his eyes. "Take off the mask and I will take you to the monitoring warehouse to check."
Lu Jue looked in the direction of Jiang Zhixia.
Jiang Zhixia:"Listen to the doctor."
Only then did he take off his mask.
The dark tattoo was exposed, and Su Chen's eyes paused almost imperceptibly, then quickly returned to normal.
It turned out to be a slave.
He had seen that video. He said yesterday that he should respect his wife, but today he broke the slave's eyes?
But being able to bring slaves for treatment is already much better than most females.
I don’t know if she is true or not when she says she wants to be nice to her main husband... Recently, in order to climb into the royal family, the mother-in-law is eager to push him to run for the third princess’s main husband.
Lu Jue lay quietly in the testing cabin.
Jiang Zhixia stood nearby, watching this good-looking doctor operating on the light screen with his well-joined hands.
Su Chen frowned, and she moved closer nervously: "How is it? Isn't it good?"
An extremely weak, but soft and warm aroma wafted over.
Su Chen's eyes moved, "Princess, the injuries on his body are all superficial injuries. The S-class male has a strong physique and will be healed in a few days."
"Where are the eyes?"
"There is nothing abnormal about his eyes. He cannot see clearly because his mental power has been suppressed for a long time and has fluctuated violently, so it is difficult to recover after being injured."
Jiang Zhixia became mute.
Just say something she doesn't have.
Su Chen was just about to say, "It's best to give him more mental power to comfort him." When the words came to his lips, he remembered this well-known C-level mental power.
Besides, few females are willing to comfort slaves.
So he changed his mind: "Princess can give him inhibitors."
Jiang Zhixia knows this stuff.
The empire developed inhibitors hundreds of years ago. If a male cannot find a female to form a contract with, he can go to the hospital to buy one with proof of abnormal mental fluctuations.
And it can only be purchased in hospitals, because excessive injection of inhibitors will also cause the death of orcs.
Jiang Zhixia recalled it and vaguely remembered that the effects of inhibitors were graded from high to low.
She was a novice now and couldn't comfort Lu Jue, so she could only make him take drugs.
"Okay, drive the best one." She waved her hand.
Su Chen calmly lowered his head and wrote on the light: "Advanced inhibitor, 30,000 gold coins each."
Jiang Zhixia: "...How much?"
Su Chen: "Thirty thousand gold coins."
Jiang Zhixia was silent.
She only had 70,000 gold coins left in her pocket.
One inhibitor can only control the susceptibility period once, which costs 30,000 yuan per month...it's really expensive.
Seeing that she didn't speak for a long time, Su Chen thought she had changed her mind.
Looking up, he saw the third princess who had always spent money moving her lips with difficulty.
"Um...can I get something in exchange?"
Su Chen: "..."
Half an hour later, Jiang Zhixia left with Lu Jue holding the medicine box in her arms.
Su Chen looked at her back with a complicated expression.
After the people left, he looked down.
In the palm of your hand is a piece of clear crystal.
Resonance crystal is valuable.
The inhibitor that the third princess exchanged with him for 300,000 gold coins.
He looked at it for a while, then accidentally got closer and smelled it.
There is a very light fragrance remaining on the crystal, which is soft and soft, making people feel inexplicably comfortable.
It smells the same as the third princess's body.
Su Chen chuckled when he remembered that she had just blinked her big eyes and discussed changing inhibitors with him without any pretense of being a princess.
"Are you sick?"
A joking voice suddenly came from behind.
